07 / FAQ

Before you ask

How do we start?

Message me on Fiverr with your files and what you need. I'll confirm the scope, the right package and the delivery time before you place an order — no payment is taken until the order starts.

What do you need from me?

For CSV cleanup: your current product file, exactly as exported. For spreadsheets: a short description of what you track (or your existing sheet). For a Notion portal: access details and your onboarding steps. I'll tell you precisely what's needed in my first reply.

Excel or Google Sheets — which do I get?

Your choice. Every spreadsheet is built in the format you pick — Excel (.xlsx) or Google Sheets — with the same formulas, dashboards and structure either way.

How many revisions do I get?

Each Fiverr package includes a set number of revisions, shown on the gig page before you order. If I made an error, fixing it is never counted against you.

How long does delivery take?

Spreadsheets and CSV cleanup: typically 2–4 days depending on package and file size. Notion portals: timeline depends on the package you choose. The exact deadline is shown on Fiverr before you order, and the order clock only starts once I've confirmed your requirements.

What if something is wrong after delivery?

Message me on Fiverr first — genuine errors get fixed. If we can't resolve it between us, Fiverr's resolution process protects your order: your payment stays in escrow until you approve the delivery. For Etsy products, message me through the shop and I'll help you get the file working.

Have a messy spreadsheet or a portal to build?

Send me the file you're dreading. I'll tell you honestly what it needs, what it costs, and how long it takes.
